1
  Intended end use identified by the log purchaser.
2
   Spruce, pine and balsam fir. Excludes balsam for log purchases in the Kalum and Kispiox Timber Supply Areas.
3
  Hemlock or balsam fir. Includes balsam for log purchases in the Kalum and Kispiox Timber Supply Areas.
4
  Cedar log prices vary significantly, depending on quality.
5
  Mixed species. Data from species/ product groups that do not meet the 3 mill minimum may be summarized under 'Other'.
6
  Logs that will produce fence posts, shake/shingle or other special forest products.
7
  Reported log prices represent averages. Individual transaction prices vary considerably due to a number of factors, such as quality, distance to market, etc.
